# Church Software UK

Church Software UK is an independent, UK-focused decision resource for church software. It helps churches compare recorded supplier information, understand trade-offs and prepare questions for suppliers.

## Key pages

- Directory: https://churchsoftware.co.uk/software/
- Categories: https://churchsoftware.co.uk/categories/
- Guides: https://churchsoftware.co.uk/guides/
- Shortlist tool: https://churchsoftware.co.uk/shortlist/
- Research methodology: https://churchsoftware.co.uk/methodology/
- Commercial disclosure: https://churchsoftware.co.uk/affiliate-disclosure/
- Privacy notice: https://churchsoftware.co.uk/privacy/
- Sitemap: https://churchsoftware.co.uk/sitemap-index.xml

## Content and evidence

Product profiles distinguish supplier-published information from directory assessment and unresolved procurement questions. Inclusion is not endorsement. The directory does not provide legal, tax, financial or safeguarding advice, publish an overall product score, or treat missing evidence as evidence of absence.

Use the source links and checked dates on each profile when current detail matters. See the methodology page for the research, correction and editorial-independence approach.
